content.value_statement: Azure apps can hide single-region, storage, and health probe gaps until an outage occurs. This skill assesses supported Azure apps and guides user-approved reliability fixes.
actual_capabilities: Assesses Azure Functions and App Service resources for zone redundancy gaps.
Checks storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region failover readiness.
Builds a feature-focused reliability checklist for the selected Azure scope.
Guides Azure CLI remediation for supported quick wins after user confirmation.
Patches Bicep or Terraform reliability settings when IaC files are present.
Offers multi-region Azure Front Door guidance after core reliability gaps are resolved.
limitations: Only Azure Functions and Azure App Service are supported in this version.
Azure authentication and the correct subscription permissions are required.
Some fixes can change live resources, restart apps, or add cloud cost.
It cannot prove application health endpoint quality without user-provided app context.

use_cases.title: Review production reliability
use_cases.description: Find missing zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health checks, and failover coverage before a planned release.

use_cases.title: Patch infrastructure definitions
use_cases.description: Update Bicep or Terraform settings so reliability improvements persist after future deployments.

use_cases.title: Plan regional failover
use_cases.description: Prepare an active-passive multi-region design with Azure Front Door and clear cost tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Assess one app
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess reliability for my Azure Function App named <app> in resource group <rg>. Show supported findings and ask before changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan safe fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my App Service reliability gaps and propose quick wins first. Include cost, downtime, and confirmation points.

prompt_templates.title: Patch IaC files
prompt_templates.prompt: Patch my Bicep or Terraform files for zone redundancy, storage redundancy, and health probes. Show the deploy plan before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Design failover
prompt_templates.prompt: After core reliability gaps are resolved, design a multi-region failover plan with Azure Front Door and paired-region guidance.

output: A feature table lists compute zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region failover.
Each row names affected resources and uses clear on, partial, or off status.
The response ends with one confirmation question before remediation.
The skill identifies Terraform resources that need reliability settings.
It separates quick wins from storage migration steps.
It asks for confirmation before planning or applying changes.

output_examples.input: Help me set up multi-region failover.
output: The skill checks that core single-region reliability is already complete.
It explains secondary region, Front Door, health probe, and cost implications.
It waits for explicit approval before generating or deploying failover changes.

best_practices: Run assessment before remediation so every change maps to a visible reliability gap.
Use IaC patching when Azure resources are managed by Bicep, Terraform, or azd.
Review cost, downtime, and migration duration before approving live changes.
anti_patterns: Do not apply storage redundancy changes without checking migration support and data impact.
Do not start multi-region work before core zone redundancy and health probes are resolved.
Do not use CLI-only fixes when IaC will later overwrite the live configuration.

faq.question: Which Azure services does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Azure Functions and Azure App Service. Other compute services are outside this version.

faq.question: Can it make changes automatically?
faq.answer: It is designed to ask before live commands, deployments, storage migrations, or source code changes.

faq.question: Does it support Bicep and Terraform?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Bicep, Terraform, Azure Verified Modules, and azd deployment flows.

faq.question: Will storage migration cause downtime?
faq.answer: It can take hours or days. Some migration paths can require downtime or careful application handling.

faq.question: Can it assess health probes?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks platform health probe settings and notes when app code must provide an endpoint.

faq.question: Is multi-region failover included?
faq.answer: Yes. It offers multi-region guidance after core single-region reliability gaps are addressed.
